title: Complete v1alpha1 reconciliation and safety contracts
description: Implement all advertised Forgejo resources, adoption, finalizers, Orphan/Delete behavior, immutable remote identities, same-namespace Secret references, generated credential lifecycle, authoritative declared-field drift, and explicit collection pruning.
acceptance_criteria: All 14 resources reconcile as documented; credentials never leak; unit and envtest coverage verifies adoption, immutability, duplicate ownership, missing references, deletion policies and Secret stability/rotation.
notes: All 14 advertised kinds have controllers; natural-key adoption and duplicate-claim rejection, immutable identity CEL rules, same-namespace Secret reads, generated Secret retention/rotation metadata, Delete-policy finalization, response-body redaction, client rate limiting, canonical Provider externalURL, request/credential/duplicate tests, pinned Nix vendor hash, reproducible static binary and OCI image. Go test/vet, controller-gen, Helm lint/render, Nix builds/check pass. Initial production rollout adopted org/repo/key/webhook/push mirror with all Synced=True, preserved remote IDs and no duplicates, and recovered after pod reschedule. Chart now supports Cilium kube-apiserver identity policy. Remaining before closing: explicit collection-pruning tests and envtest/integration coverage against Forgejo 15.
